chapter_title: A Homage to Our Brave Soldiers

items.title: Homage means showing respect publicly
items.explanation: A Homage is something that is said or done to show respect publicly for someone. Every Indian should pay homage to the brave soldiers who sacrificed their lives for the country.

items.title: Identify the National War Memorial
items.explanation: The monument described in the text is the National War Memorial, located near India Gate in Bengaluru. It was envisioned and inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in February 2019.
